topic: Massage for tradies: shoulders, forearms and lower back

slides.headline: Tradie body feeling every job?
slides.sub: What remedial massage can and can't do for work-worn muscles.

slides.title: Shoulders from overhead work
slides.body: Hours of drilling, painting or installing overhead can leave your shoulders and upper back tight and tired. Massage around the shoulder blades and neck can ease that tension for a while.

slides.title: Forearms that grip all day
slides.body: Tools, drills and ladders mean constant gripping. Forearm and hand work can ease that tight, achy feeling, and gentle wrist and finger stretches between jobs help keep it in check.

slides.title: Lower back from bending and lifting
slides.body: Lifting, kneeling and bending over benches adds up across a week. Massage to the lower back, glutes and hips can help things feel easier to move, especially after a big stretch of work.

slides.title: Pair it with movement
slides.body: Massage feels good, but strength and variety do the heavy lifting. A few minutes of movement at smoko and some strength work each week help your body keep up with the job.

slides.title: When to get it checked
slides.body: Pins and needles in the hands, pain that wakes you at night, weakness, or an injury from a specific incident at work should be assessed. Our team can refer you to a physio.

slides.headline: Book in after the big week
slides.body: Our remedial massage therapists work with your job in mind and will tell you when a physio review makes more sense. Book online via the link in bio.

caption:
Sparky, chippy, plumber or painter: your body is your most important tool.

Overhead work loads the shoulders, constant gripping tires the forearms, and all that bending and lifting lands in the lower back. By Friday, a lot of tradies feel it.

Remedial massage can ease that tight, worn-out feeling for a while, and it works even better paired with a bit of movement at smoko and some regular strength work. If you've got pins and needles, pain at night or a specific injury on the job, get it assessed first.

Our remedial massage therapists at Hybrid Physiotherapy work alongside our physios. Book online via the link in bio.

General information only — not a substitute for an individual assessment.

story.body: Massage eases the tightness. A few minutes of movement at smoko helps it last longer.
